linkedinReason: The Nostr WoT team published a practical tutorial and seven-language guide explaining how signed events move through clients and relays, helping users diagnose missing posts without creating duplicates.
linkedin:
A signed Nostr event can be valid and still be missing from another app.

The path has four independent steps: a client builds the event, a signer authorizes it, write relays decide whether to store it, and each reader queries its own relay set. Relay overlap, retention and filters determine what appears.

The turn: signing protects integrity, not delivery.

Our new tutorial and seven-language guide show how to inspect that path before publishing again and creating a duplicate.

The guide states the limit plainly: relay overlap improves discovery but does not guarantee permanent storage.
